main_rule: 65+ share >= P60 AND residential land beyond NEC 800 m >= P60; equal STPUG weights; ties included
validation_scope: All 27 scenario memberships independently recalculated from supplied proximity outputs; retained counts and residential totals checked. This is not an independent rerun of the full proximity geoprocessing.
comparison_rule: Fixed 20% ageing / 30% gap selects 14; main percentile rule selects 13. Group 149 belongs only to the fixed comparison.
site_scope: Local gains for retained groups; 14-area global portfolio totals are excluded.
